config.script:
measureInfo = self.view.custom.measures.selectedData[0] if len(self.view.custom.measures.selectedData) == 1 else None
	if measureInfo is None: return

	msg = "Are you sure you want to delete this measure?"
	system.perspective.openPopup("UserConfirmPopup", "kanoa/core/templates/inputs/confirm",  {'text':msg, 'messageHandler':'deleteMeasureMsg', 'inputPayload': {'measureInfo': measureInfo}}, title='Delete Measure', modal=True, overlayDismiss=True)
	
	return

customMethods.name: delete
customMethods.script:
system.perspective.print("deleteMeasure() called with %s"%measureInfo)
	success, msg = system.kanoa.measures.deleteMeasure(measureInfo['measureId'], self.view.custom.security.userId)
	if not success: system.perspective.sendMessage('showWarningToast', {'message': 'Unable to delete measure. %s'%msg})
	else:
		if measureInfo['tagPath']:
			retVals = system.tag.deleteTags([measureInfo['tagPath']])
			system.perspective.print("system.tag.deleteTags() called with %s returned %s"%(measureInfo['tagPath'], retVals))
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', {'message': 'Measure has been deleted.'})
	
	self.clearSelection()
	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.measures.data")
	
	return
